reviews.quote: The Surface Pro 11 starts at $1,000, without a keyboard or stylus and configured with a Snapdragon X Plus (10 core CPU), 16GB RAM, 256GB SSD and the old LCD display, which is fine but nothing stellar.

professional.notes: X Plus not separately benchmarked by CNET; ratings inferred from X Elite OLED anchor (SHARED-surface-pro.md). BBY user aggregate for THIS SKU: 4.63★/99.

praises: 4.63★/99 on BBY — buyers call it the battery-life sweet spot of the Pro 11 line
Fanless and silent even under multitasking; no coil whine reports at this tier
Performance barely drops on battery — CNET verified near-plugged speeds
Kickstand + pen tablet mode praised for note-taking and markup work
Replaceable SSD under the kickstand — rare upgrade path for a thin tablet
complaints: Keyboard is a separate purchase (~CA$200 more) — sticker price misleads
LCD is 60Hz and dimmer/duller than the OLED sibling; glossy glass is reflective
ARM translation gaps persist for niche apps, plugins, anti-cheat games
16GB RAM (shared with GPU) fills under heavy tab loads; soldered, no upgrade

design_philosophy: Microsoft's flagship detachable tablet: fanless ARM silicon, 3:2 touch/kickstand design, and Copilot+ NPU in an 895 g package. This X Plus 512GB LCD tier is the volume value config at CA retail — the same chassis and 45-TOPS NPU as the OLED models, trading display and GPU bin for price and best-in-line endurance.
rating_notes: Inferred from CNET 8.3 X Elite OLED anchor (SHARED-surface-pro.md): LCD 60Hz vs OLED → screen_quality −2.3; X Plus GPU bin → gaming −0.7, productivity −1.0; LCD endurance → battery +0.5; Signature Keyboard → keyboard_trackpad −1.0. Same as 20-entry except 512GB storage and verified pricing.
